title: Bevy HTML Tag to BUI IR Node Type Mapping
description: Maps standard HTML tags to Bevy AI UI Parser BuiNodeType values. Generated from bevy_ai_ui_parser/src/core/model/ir.rs and spawn.rs.

buiNodeTypes.Node: Generic visual container (div-like). Renders as Bevy Node with Flex layout.
buiNodeTypes.Text: Text label node. Renders text content via Bevy Text component.
buiNodeTypes.TextInput: Editable text input field. Mirrors to a hidden DOM input for browser preview.
buiNodeTypes.Toggle: Checkbox/toggle switch. Maps to Bevy Checkable + Checked components.
buiNodeTypes.Button: Interactive button. Maps to Bevy Button component with Interaction tracking.
buiNodeTypes.Slider: Range slider control. Maps to bevy_ui_widgets::Slider with value/range/step.
buiNodeTypes.Image: Image display node. Loads texture via AssetServer, supports atlas layouts.

containers.notes: All block-level semantic containers map to generic Node. Layout is driven by CSS flex/grid.

text.notes: All inline and block text elements map to Text. Font styling comes from CSS. <a> tags do NOT produce clickable links in-game; use data-action instead.

button.notes: Must have data-action attribute for interaction binding. Optional: data-action-event (click|hover_enter|hover_exit|focus|blur).

input_text.condition: type='text' or type='password' or type='email' or type='number' or type='search' or type='tel' or type='url' or absent (defaults to text)
input_text.notes: Must have id attribute for state binding. Placeholder text supported via placeholder attribute.

input_checkbox.notes: Initial checked state from 'checked' attribute. Must have id for state binding.

input_range.notes: min/max/step attributes map to SliderRange and SliderStep. Default: min=0, max=100, step=1.

select.notes: Dropdown is NOT a native BuiNodeType. Rendered as Node container with child Button items. Use data-action on each option button. Future: DropdownField may be added to parser.

img.notes: src attribute maps to asset path. Supports PNG, JPG, WEBP. Atlas slicing via data-atlas-* attributes.

style.notes: Parser reads CSS from <style> blocks before compiling UI nodes. Keep CSS contract-compliant; prefer external stylesheets for OD package output when possible.

table_layout.reason: Table layout has no Bevy UI equivalent. Use CSS Grid or Flexbox instead.
table_layout.alternative: Replace with div.grid or div.flex structure.

media.reason: No engine equivalent for embedded media playback or canvas rendering within UI tree.
media.alternative: Use Image nodes for static visuals. Video/audio must be handled outside the UI parser.

iframe.reason: No sandboxed browsing context in game UI.
iframe.alternative: None. Embedding external content is not supported.

script.reason: Arbitrary JavaScript execution is not supported. Interactions use data-action -> ECS event binding.
script.alternative: Use data-action attributes on interactive elements. Logic lives in Bevy ECS systems.

meta_link_favicon.reason: Browser metadata has no meaning in game UI context.
meta_link_favicon.alternative: Omit entirely from game UI HTML.

list_semantic.reason: Semantic list elements have no dedicated BuiNodeType. They render as Node but lose semantic meaning.
list_semantic.alternative: Use div with role='list' or plain div.children structure. Visual bullets via ::before pseudo-elements in CSS.

form_controls_advanced.reason: These controls have no direct BuiNodeType mapping. textarea -> TextInput (single-line only). progress/meter -> custom Node with fill overlay.
form_controls_advanced.alternative: textarea: use TextInput with multiline workaround (not recommended). progress: use Node with child Image fill bar.

id.purpose: State binding target. Must be unique within document.

data-action.purpose: ECS event emission key. Format: 'action_name' or 'action_name:param'.

data-action-event.purpose: Override default click event. Values: click | hover_enter | hover_exit | focus | blur.

data-binding.purpose: Two-way state binding source. Format: 'state_key' matching BuiStateModel.values.

data-atlas-columns.purpose: Number of columns in sprite atlas texture.

data-atlas-rows.purpose: Number of rows in sprite atlas texture.
